exams.title: Mutual Fund Distributors
exams.blurb: The licence to distribute mutual funds in India. Twelve units, taught as concepts, examples and traps.

exams.title: Securities Markets Foundation
exams.blurb: The entry-level certification on how Indian securities markets work, from shares and IPOs to funds, derivatives and financial planning.

exams.title: Equity Derivatives
exams.blurb: Futures and options on shares and indices: contracts, pricing, payoffs, strategies, clearing, margins and the rules.

exams.title: Investment Adviser (Level 1)
exams.blurb: The SEBI-mandated certification for investment advisers: markets, products, risk, planning, insurance, retirement, tax and ethics.

exams.title: Research Analyst
exams.blurb: Economy, industry, company, valuation and technicals, plus the SEBI rules for publishing research. Fifteen chapters, deeply worked.

exams.title: Portfolio Management Services (PMS) Distributors
exams.blurb: What distributors need to know to offer portfolio management services: how PMS works, who it suits, how it is measured, taxed and regulated.

exams.title: Alternative Investment Funds (Category I and II) Distributors
exams.blurb: Private equity, venture, debt and real-estate funds explained for distributors: structure, fees, due diligence, documents, valuation and tax.

exams.title: Equity Sales
exams.blurb: The broking professional's licence: markets, regulation, IPOs, trading, risk management, settlement, surveillance and client handling.

exams.title: Currency Derivatives
exams.blurb: Currency markets, forwards, futures and options on USD-INR and other pairs, strategies, trading, settlement, regulation and tax.

exams.title: Investment Adviser (Level 2)
exams.blurb: Advanced planning for SEBI-registered investment advisers: insurance, retirement, tax, estate, behaviour and full financial plans.
